message: well danielle this is a last reply sorry..but as for the 90 days it is nothing to do with the customers number at all were limiting the calls to that number..its not for the actual customeras for the prepaid funds never making it to the inmate it won't they are not the facility in order to send the funds to the inmate it needs to be sent to the facility.. anyways i can argue all day to the fact the cbs which is the billing department you call are a company working for the customer.. anyways as for the calls being disconnected have you ever thought to ask for a credit on any of those calls.. Also funds do not disappear on a prepaid acct unless they sit there for over 180 days a refund is always available upon request.. I am sorry to hear everybody has so many trouble.. my experience with cbs/evercom(which is no longer) t-netix (also no longer)/Securus which is the company that owns the phones has been wonderful i have a prepaid acct i can pay over the internet when i pay my regular home bills.. no need to contact a representative unless i seek credit for coc ..in that case I am aware there needs to be an immediate cb or under 3 minutes.. hope everybody else that has a good experience can post so they do not turn everybody off cbc since they are a wonderful company
